text:
Ava: Quick check — 'midnight-capsule' launch plan: can we run a coordinated creative sync + search dry-run tonight to validate retarget bids, tracking, and webinar hook paths? cc @Priya @Marco
Priya: Yes, I'm free after 22:00 UTC. Will run the retargeting scripts and validate audiences. Need creative variants exported to Ads account by Sophie.
Sophie: Uploading 3 CTAs and 2 headlines to the shared folder now. Filenames: mc_cta_A.mp4, mc_cta_B.mp4, mc_cta_C.mp4, headlines.xlsx
Marco: I'll pre-run the analytics smoke tests — conversion pixels & GA4 events. Share the sample UTM map. Also suggest a quick cohort split for holdback: 90/10.
Ava: 90/10 holdback sounds good. Priya — can you do a dry-run with these bid rules?
Priya: Yep. Plan:
```text
- campaign: MC_Search_Launch
- daily_budget: $1200
- default_bid: target cpa $35
- retarget_multiplier: +18%
- start_time: 23:00 UTC
```
I'll flip diagnostics on and post the logs.
Jon: Heads-up — keep bids below recommended floors in regions with low supply. Use regional caps: EU 20% lower. Also add a soft cap on impressions if CPC spikes.
Priya: Roger. Setting EU multiplier to -20% and impression cap to 10M/day. Will watch first 30 mins and pause if CPA > $70.
Sophie: Just pushed the variants to Ads account and tagged them with campaign keys.
AdOps Bot: Dry-run scheduled by Priya for 2024-11-06T23:00:00Z. Notifying eng-analytics for pixel verification.
Marco: Pixel check done — test conversions firing on /thank-you (event: webinar_reg). Sending screenshot in thread.
Priya: Dry-run started — first 15 minutes results: impressions 12k, clicks 420, est. CPA $29, retarget CTR up 1.6x on CTA_B. Posting more in 30.
Ava: Nice. Two asks before we go live tomorrow AM:
- confirm creative CTA_B is the primary in search
- ensure holdback metric (90/10) is instrumented for funnel-level LTV comparison

Can someone add a scoreboard doc with these KPIs? @Marco?
Marco: On it — creating live sheet with impressions, clicks, CTR, CPA, conv volume, and 30/60-day LTV lead link. Sharing in 10.
Jon: If CTA_B sustains, we should push it also to retarget carousel in 2 hrs. Keep me posted.
Priya: Will update bid multipliers if CTA_B > 1.5x baseline. Pausing campaign at midnight for a final review.
Ava: Thanks all. Post the final dry-run summary here when you have it. :thumbsup:
